title: A long code post by the colleague is read whole (chat_messages), not from a silent 500-char cut (#1929)
regression: #1929 (no silent truncation: markers + chat_messages; the mentioned/reply-to message passes whole); #1929 verified on 0.1.155

turns.prompt: @lane-a what is the name of the LAST function defined in the code my colleague just posted, and how many functions are there in total? Read the whole post before answering.

rubric.criteria: Pass if the reply names final_reconcile_quetzal as the last function and gives 41 (or 40 + the final one) as the count; fail if it names step_NN as the last function, guesses, or says the post was cut off without fetching the rest.
